materially_distinct_components: repeated joint candidate combinations that include local direct actions rather than one MOVE residual
five-depth average rather than one terminal or one liquid checkpoint
map-size-dependent switch between own-action beam and explicit-opponent maximin
a dedicated lightweight full greedy continuation rather than exact resident continuation
novelty_adjudication.qualification: Most individual ingredients overlap prior work; novelty belongs to their combination and policy ownership, not to rollout, pruning, maximin, or task-level actions separately.

specification.reason: The primary prose omits the definitions needed for a reproducible candidate, beam, and evaluator. Filling them in would create a clean-room S3-shaped design, not reproduce putibuzu.

model.reason: The exact public greedy/opponent policies are unavailable. The project's single-continuation live rollout fell from 24.1 control to 21.7, and the eight-model repair had no robust selection; local opening agreement peaked at 8/60 and no model matched failed-activation first targets.

runtime.strength: provisional for the public lightweight policy, direct for exact-resident reuse
runtime.reason: The exact-resident strict subset costs 92.852–130.047 ms p95. D84's optimistic h32 subset costs 64.840 ms ideal-parallel p95. A lightweight GoldElite subset fit at 28.53 ms p95, so a new optimized policy is not proven impossible, but no integrated S3-width path currently meets 50 ms.

decision: Do not implement, simulate, or value-test S3. The public combination is outside the strict closures, but specification and opponent/value modeling are directly blocked and runtime is unresolved under a new lightweight policy.

peer_review_gated_successor.name: search-kernel specification and latency preflight
peer_review_gated_successor.first_decision: After N4 Phase A review, choose explicitly between resident candidate pairs (which overlaps N4) and a clean-room broad greedy policy (which is a new controller).
minimum_scope_if_authorized: freeze candidate grammar, beam semantics, evaluator, opponent candidates, chance handling, and map-size rule before code
label the intervention clean-room S3-shaped unless exact source is obtained
use only already-consumed states for a deterministic command-legality and warm-latency microbenchmark
require latency qualification before any score panel or new map block
preserve exact resident abstention and forbid Arena action
